title: thebasics:thebasics-handbook-title-scene-markers
text: Scene markers hold persistent roleplay descriptions without filling a build with large written signs. Craft one from any two loose stones, then place the small marker flat on the ground or against a wall. Writing and reading - Hold Shift and right-click a placed marker to edit its optional title, body, and presentation. - Choose Environmental description for in-fiction narration, or OOC notice for explicit production notes. - Look directly at a written marker to see its description over the world. The floating symbol invites nearby players to inspect it. - Break a marker to pick it up with its title, description, presentation, and author metadata intact. Hold Shift and right-click the item to read it. Editing follows normal land-claim permissions. Scene markers are durable world content, separate from temporary /envhere and !! cast messages and separate from local or global OOC chat settings. Locking The creator can choose Save & lock in the editor. No padlock item is needed. Locked markers remain readable and open read-only. Only the creator or a server admin with claim access can unlock them in the editor or pick them up. Locks and creator identity survive pickup and replacement. Appearance Use the symbol tiles and preview to choose an exclamation, question, or information billboard. The camera-facing symbol gently bobs in place. Billboard distance accepts 1-1024 blocks (default 24). Unlimited removes the distance fade but still requires loaded terrain. Walls obscure the billboard. Symbol and distance settings survive pickup and replacement, and locked markers must be unlocked before changing them.
